title: policy.json: attention
description: The ceiling the owner sets on each person's attention budget (design part 23.5). The budget itself is the person's own, in the person file (attention.*); the lower of the person's value and the ceiling applies, so a project may be stricter than a person and never looser.

decisions_per_digest_max.description: The most decisions that may be in front of one person at once through digests, whatever their own setting.

interrupts_per_day_max.description: The most questions that may be sent at once to one person in any 24 hours, whatever their own setting.
